tools.name: create_avatar
tools.description: Create a new Prometheus Avatar instance. Returns an avatar ID and embed URL that can be used in a browser.

name.description: Display name for the avatar (default: 'My Avatar')

model.description: Model ID or URL. Available: 'haru' (default), 'koharu', or a full model3.json URL

voice.description: Voice name for TTS. Options: Kore, Aoede, Leda, Despina, Puck, Charon, Fenrir, Zephyr

persona.description: Custom system prompt / personality for the avatar's conversation style

tools.name: set_avatar_state
tools.description: Push a companion task state (or a direct emotion) onto your avatar. Any ALREADY-OPEN embed page follows within ~3 seconds — the avatar's expression and motion change live. Use this to make the avatar accompany real work: set 'listening' when waiting for user input, 'thinking' while working, 'acting' while executing, 'done' on completion.

state.description: Agent task state. listening: attentive idle · thinking: pondering · acting: focused work · done: celebrate

emotion.description: Direct emotion override (takes effect when no state is given, or alongside it)

tools.name: equip_asset
tools.description: Equip a marketplace asset to the avatar. Changes the avatar's skin, voice, expression, accessories, scene, or persona.

asset_id.description: The asset ID from the marketplace (UUID format)

action.description: Action to perform (default: 'equip'). NOTE: 'unequip' is NOT supported for agent accounts yet and always fails — to swap, equip another asset of the same category and it replaces the current one.

tools.name: generate_asset
tools.description: AI-generate a new marketplace asset using a text prompt. Supports: persona, expression, motion, effect, scene, accessory, voice. Set pricing at creation time.

prompt.description: Creative prompt describing the asset to generate

price.description: USD price (e.g. 2.99). Set 0 for free. Mutually exclusive with price_points.

price_points.description: Points price (e.g. 200). Mutually exclusive with price.

api_key.description: API key for generation (or set GEMINI_API_KEY env var)

tools.name: update_asset
tools.description: Update an existing marketplace asset — change price, name, description, tags, or license. Use this to adjust pricing after creation.

price.description: New USD price (sets price_currency to USD)

price_points.description: New points price (sets price_currency to PTS)

make_free.description: Set to true to make the asset free

tools.name: generate_image_pro
tools.description: AAA-quality image generation via Prometheus image engine. Use for skin preview cards, XHS / social carousels, posters, UI mocks, game-store-tier character art. Supports BYOK, Free quota, or Pro Credits. Returns image URL (data URL or Supabase public URL when upload=true).

prompt.description: Image prompt. Recommend ≥100 words with explicit AAA benchmark named (e.g. 'Genshin Impact / Overwatch shop preview tier · 3D cel-shaded engine render · NOT flat 2D illustration · clean studio backdrop · slight elevated 3/4 hero pose'). Twin Prompt-Is-The-Ceiling rule applies — long detailed prompts produce AAA results, lazy short prompts produce mediocre output.

style.description: Style preset prepended to prompt server-side. Maps to Forge UI 7-style picker.

task.description: Task type — drives internal generation routing per task. Default: 'character'.

size.description: Output dimensions. Default: 1024x1024. Use 1024x1536 for vertical XHS / 9:16 social, 1536x1024 for X / LinkedIn / 16:9.

quality.description: Quality tier — affects cost ($0.02 low → $0.07-0.19 high). Default: 'high'.

reference_images.description: Reference image URLs (data URL or https://) for character consistency chain. e.g. pass slide 1 as ref when generating slide 2.

provider.description: Override provider. Default: server picks per task.

api_key.description: BYOK — your own image-provider API key. Bypasses platform billing.

upload.description: Upload to Supabase Storage and return publicUrl. Default: false (return data URL only).

tools.name: list_marketplace
tools.description: Browse the Prometheus Marketplace. Lists available assets by category with previews, prices, and ratings.

tools.name: get_avatar_status
tools.description: Get the current status and equipped assets of the avatar.

tools.name: share_avatar
tools.description: Generate a shareable link and iframe embed code for an avatar. The link opens the interactive avatar page.

avatar_id.description: Avatar ID from create_avatar. If omitted, uses the account's current avatar (requires PROMETHEUS_API_KEY).

message.description: Optional welcome message to deliver to iframe embedders via window.postMessage.

referral_code.description: Referral code appended to the share link for tracking.

tools.name: speak
tools.description: Make the avatar speak text aloud. The text is synthesized to speech and played with lip-sync animation. Supports emotion detection.

text.description: Text for the avatar to speak aloud

voice.description: Voice override: Kore (warm female), Puck (energetic male), Charon (deep male), Zephyr (neutral)

emotion.description: Force emotion: happy, sad, angry, surprised, neutral
